component.name: SnapPea
component.summary: Screenshots and screen recording for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: SnapPea captures a region or a screen, annotates the result, and records the screen. It implements the Screenshot portal.

ul.li: Pen, highlighter, shapes, text, redaction, pixelation and a loupe
Screen recording with hardware encoding and live drawing
A trimmer for recordings, with GIF and video export
Text recognition and QR code detection on the selection

description.p: Annotations can be selected after drawing to recolor, resize or reshape them, text labels get a background, and the magnifier shows a separate source circle. A click without a drag selects the window under it. Recordings can open in the editor and stop before the disk fills. Fixes for stray shapes on other outputs, failed saves, lost annotations in all-screens captures, and pointer and toolbar glitches.

Audio recording: system audio, the microphone, or both, with a mute button and live level meter in the recording toolbar. The editor shows the audio track, keeps it when exporting, and can remove it. Default save folders are Screenshots and Screencasts. Fixes the microphone pop at the start of a recording and a stuck portal after a lost Wayland connection.
Toggle for the recording region border, Enter as the capture key, no default capture delay, and fixes for the border at screen edges and delayed capture.
